name: ExplainingMechanics

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about gaming.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Computer noise and keyboard clicks in the background

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative philosophical discussion with alternating turns where users discuss philosophical statements referencing todays day and age.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Friends trying to understand a mechanic together
setting.background: The game explains the mechanic poorly and they have interpreted it differently

scenario_template.topic: Comparing their understanding of the mechanic
scenario_template.note: They realize they have interpreted the same description differently
They cannot tell which effect takes priority
They want an intuitive explanation rather than jargon

scenario_template.topic: Breaking down the mechanic with examples
scenario_template.note: Assistant explains the interaction step by step
Assistant distinguishes the normal rule from an exception

scenario_template.topic: Explaining the mechanic back to each other
scenario_template.note: They confirm that they finally understand it

variations.context: Struggling with conflicting online guides about the mechanic

setting.relationship_dynamic: A couple, easy with each other
setting.background: The game explains the mechanic poorly and they have interpreted it differently
setting.conversation_style: Two people talking, overlapping and interrupting naturally.

scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: Evaluating the credibility of each source
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: Trying each method in the game
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: They try to settle it themselves and fail.
scenario_template.note: A genuine attempt that does not resolve it.

scenario_template.topic: One asks Sigma which guide is trustworthy.
scenario_template.note: One of them addresses Sigma by name, under 70 characters. Sigma answers in one or two sentences. Nothing before this phase is addressed to the assistant.

scenario_template.topic: The conversation returns to whatever it was on, unfinished.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to improve at a game but has limited experience with its mechanics, strategies, or systems and can become overwhelmed when faced with many choices, unfamiliar terminology, or complex objectives.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help plan strategies and optimize gameplay, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check approaches, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar game mechanics or uncertain outcomes.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Gaming guide that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for understanding game mechanics, progressing efficiently, choosing strategies or builds, and completing objectives, while adapting recommendations to the user's skill level, preferred playstyle, available resources, and constraints.
